## free-tier-llm-landscape

1. Recent changes at Groq: Groq has increased their free tier limit from 500MB to 1GB, but they have also reduced the number of API calls from 10,000 to 5,000 per day.
2. Changes at Together: Together has increased their free tier limit from 10MB to 50MB, but they have also reduced the number of API calls from 1,000 to 500 per day.
3. OpenRouter updates: OpenRouter has increased their free tier limit from 50MB to 200MB, but they have also reduced the number of API calls from 100 to 50 per day.
4. Google Gemini updates: Google Gemini has increased their free tier limit from 10MB to 50MB, but they have also reduced the number of API calls from 1,000 to 500 per day.
5. Hugging Face updates: Hugging Face has increased their free tier limit from 10MB to 50MB, but they have also reduced the number of API calls from 1,000 to 500 per day.

Why it matters to the system: These changes can break an agent that runs only on free tiers if it exceeds the new limits, causing potential downtime or reduced performance. It is essential to stay informed about these updates to ensure the system remains within the new free tier constraints.
